title: Born to a Living Hope
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Peter writes to people scattered across the provinces, resident strangers holding an address that was never the real one. And the first thing he calls them is not refugees. He calls them elect exiles, chosen and away from home in the same breath. That is the whole letter in two words. Week 1 walks through the living hope, the inheritance no thief reaches and no market moves, the faith proved genuine in the fire, and the ransom paid not with silver or gold but with the precious blood of Christ.
subtitle: 1 and 2 Peter Week 1
